description: A live-model contract case that requires deterministic finding persistence and explicit finalization.

input.prompt_template: You are running an isolated Ladon reviewer contract test. Read the diff at {{file:inputs/review.diff}}. The unbounded retry is a confirmed medium-severity operability finding in src/retry.ts. Call mcp__ladon_findings__record_finding exactly once for that finding with posted_inline false. Then call mcp__ladon_findings__finalize_review exactly once with analysis_complete true and a concise summary. The MCP state, not your final text, is the result. Do not run commands, edit files, or use any other tools.
